generation_policy: Contract-gated: generated only for previously uncovered L2 features with a nonblank L2 what contract; contract contents are treated as provisionally correct per user instruction.

feature.description: Perform smoke test run, make sure POC runs, outputs are in the right format, and faliures can be observed.

contract.purpose_user_function: Run planned smoke/tests and verifier gates to show the artifact starts, produces expected-format outputs, and exposes failures through logs/evidence.
contract.valid_inputs: Integrated artifact, approved test commands, expected outputs/formats, test paths, proof obligations, runtime/environment, and failure conditions.
contract.expected_outputs: Test report, session log, patch diff where relevant, artifact manifest, verifier result, and pass/fail/inconclusive evidence.
contract.state_side_effects: Executes authorized tests, records node/gate status, and permits or blocks handoff.
contract.failure_rejection_behavior: Gate fails visibly on nonzero test/runtime result, missing output/evidence, invalid format, timeout, unauthorized command, or verifier rejection.
contract.supported_boundaries_exclusions: Generic TestRunner/Verifier readiness is supported; domain-specific POC smoke semantics require explicit test definitions.
contract.success_evidence: `harness/lib/graph_node_dispatcher.py` requires `handoff_md`, `session_log`, and for code/test tasks `patch_diff`/`test_report`, then publishes an artifact manifest.
contract.granularity_atomic_contracts: Test startup, expected output, schema/format, observable failure log, timeout, missing artifact, nonzero test, verifier rejection, and successful smoke run.
contract.readme_product_docs: README.md#Basic Workflow; README.md#Governed Planning; README.md#Appendix: AutoSci Commands; docs/integrations/autosci/full-parity-progress-report.md#Remaining Partial/Gated Routes documents incomplete global parity, provider-gated routes, and remaining semantic-proof gaps.

contract.implementation_entrypoints: harness/lib/graph_node_dispatcher.py::_node_evaluation_plan and artifact publication; harness/lib/plan_validator.py gate validation
